description:
Source issue: https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/834
Parent contract: zaq-zqq (read before implementation).

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Final review of all #834 production/test/docs changes. No speculative production changes in this task; any discovered correction must be tracked with tests and approval gates as applicable. Record commands/results and exceptions in Beadwork and eventual PR.
Tests to add before implementation: downstream tasks must already have tests first. Verify coverage matrix includes live, queued, steering, canonical/legacy restore, both search forms, timestamps/provenance, trust failures, merge/missing identity, property invariants and provider-boundary payloads. Add reproductions for any discovered gap before its fix. No new browser E2E planned because there is no UI change; reassess if scope expands.
Branches/paths validated: preserve native tool exchange, attachments, existing history isolation/cursors/permissions, raw persistence/admission, and common lookup/formatting. Verify no fresh message timestamps, runtime rename-refresh, author/time refs, RequestTransformer renderer, or legacy Retrieval migration slipped in.
Mocking plan: only external APIs; real domain/Repo/runtime integration.
Documentations to update: Beadwork validation notes and PR summary linking #834; record explicit existing-test approval evidence.
Action reuse assessment: final review must verify shared People lookup, Conversations projections, existing History Action, shared InputPrompt and Factory/Jido prompt path; no duplicated operations or bypassed permission/service boundaries.
Validation: issue-level isolated tests and mix q after each implementation issue. After implementation and review approval, follow dedicated coverage phase (fresh mix coveralls.json, timeout 600000 ms, then mix coverup only on success; approved coverage tooling as available). Run final mix precommit with 900000 ms timeout after all corrections/coverage; repeat required checks after changes. Record blockers instead of claiming success.
Acceptance: prepare PR referencing/closes #834 only when implementation is verified; link that PR to the session. Obtain final human approval after gates pass. Commit/push/merge only with explicit authorization, never directly to main. This planning session must not mark implementation complete.

Additional explicit test approval: user selected "Approve assertion update" in this session for test/zaq/agent/server_manager_test.exs:379. Preserve exact equality, changing job-only prompt to original job plus InputPrompt.system_instruction/0; all other assertions unchanged. Broader pre-fix run: 6 doctests, 17 properties, 826 tests, one failure solely at this disclosed assertion. Prior implementation tasks .1-.8 complete. Review/coverage/final-gate/authorized Git landing remain pending.

Regression validation after explicitly approved ServerManager assertion update: mix q passed (hooks, formatting, Credo, docs, warnings-as-errors compile); combined 26-suite run passed: 6 doctests, 17 properties, 826 tests, 0 failures, 203.8s. Includes Engine API/Conversations/People conversations/canonical history/ingress/BO projections and Agent API/Factory/ServerManager/Executor/native controls/loader/history sync/attachments/recall/workflow seed suites.
Self-review: shared People batching reused by BO, Messages and recall; trusted author persistence and original source time retained; legacy loader selects only needed fields (no trace hydration); no fresh processing timestamps, author/time refs, RequestTransformer renderer, runtime rename-refresh, new tool exposure, or Retrieval caller migration. git diff --check clean before final state check.
Remaining gates: code review approval before dedicated fresh coverage phase; required coverage tooling/report and fixes; final mix precommit (900000ms timeout) after those gates; PR/Git mutations only when authorized. No claim of numerical coverage or final precommit success. No commit, push or PR created. Leave task/epic open until delivery gates are satisfied. Implementation lives on feature/issue-834-message-attribution.

comments.text: User approved implementation and authorized commit/push. Fresh full mix coveralls.json attempted with 600000ms budget; inner process timed out (ETIMEDOUT), so report is not accepted and mix coverup was not run. Run reported 43 doctests, 242 properties, 9587 tests, 16 failures, 1 skipped before termination. Isolated follow-up across factory_runtime_failure, mattermost_shared_history_integration, history_strategy_full_flow, nested_run_agent_integration: 37 tests, 9 failures. Confirmed 2 Factory tests expect job-only prompt; 5 Mattermost cases expect old channel author prefix/casing; 2 nested-agent tests fail with mandatory_payload_too_large (requires investigation, no weakened assertion). Additional exact existing-test changes need approval. No source/test changes made in this follow-up; commit and push paused pending validation blockers.

Explicit approval received via question: user selected Fix and validate (Recommended). Approved scope: Factory retry tests expect original job plus shared instruction; Mattermost history assertions expect directory-author headers instead of channel prefix/casing, preserving retry/privacy/order/tool assertions. Investigate nested-agent context-window failures without weakening success assertions. Commit/push authorization remains active after successful validation.

Nested-agent reproduction: both T1/T2 fail in isolation with mandatory_payload_too_large. Fixtures use the ordinary configured-agent default model_max_context_tokens=5000; shared 414-character instruction adds mandatory prompt overhead. Correction will shorten the existing InputPrompt.system_instruction text without changing metadata meaning, roles, budgets, fixture scenarios or success assertions. Action reuse: extend existing renderer-owned instruction; no new operation/Action/generation path. Existing nested integration failures serve as red regressions.

Additional explicit approval: user selected Approve 6,000-token fixture. Nested integration X/Y fixtures may set model_max_context_tokens=6000 instead of default 5000, preserving success/identity/permission/tool assertions and all production limits/guards. Diagnostic in-memory RequestTransformer instrumentation (no host file edits) measured parent continuation estimate=972 vs input budget=858 after shared instruction shortening. New metadata overhead causes expected fail-safe rejection; successful nested-exchange fixture needs explicit capacity. No production budgeting changes.

Explicit approval: user selected Approve scoped validation. Approved two HistoryStrategyFullFlowTest assertion sites (channel bob/bob prefix -> directory author headers), fresh affected-suite coverage instead of successful full-suite coverage, then precommit. Second full coverage attempt again ETIMEDOUT; partial summary 48 doctests, 228 properties, 9166 tests, six failures at those two old-author sites. Do not accept timeout status=0 as success or reuse reports. No coverage-upper agent is available in this harness; perform equivalent fresh coverage/coverup command workflow directly and report scope/limitations. Factory/nested/Mattermost suites now 37 tests, zero failures.

Fresh approved scoped coverage succeeded: mix coveralls.json over 30 affected suites, 274.7s, 6 doctests, 17 properties, 900 tests, 0 failures (21 excluded). Only after success, mix coverup passed. Scoped whole-repository total 26.0% is NOT full-suite coverage. New InputPrompt 100%, MessageAuthor 96.8%; HistoryLoader 96.2%, recall 96.9%, BO projection 100%, canonical transcript 96.3%. Existing large contexts have unexercised unrelated paths; Retrieval 0% here is docs-only change. Changed-line gaps are defensive/compatibility fallbacks (nil/negative recall limit path, invalid legacy binding, NaiveDateTime support, missing-role/unsupported canonical replay); no hidden successes claimed. Full-suite reports from two timed-out attempts rejected. Full strategy test checks exact header/body against persisted source time and directory author; production fixture directory names may differ from provider username. Final precommit pending.

Final mix precommit passed against the final changes with 900000ms budget: 735.1s, 17 doctests, 189 properties, 9690 tests, zero failures, one skipped (117 excluded); formatting/Credo/warnings-as-errors compile passed. User authorization to commit/push remains explicit and scoped to feature/issue-834-message-attribution; no merge authorized. Approved scoped coverage exception and individual test behavior changes recorded above. Proceeding to commit/push; keep task/epic open for PR delivery, no issue-834 resolution claim.
